Only PDF files are allowed.") try: # Generate a unique identifier for the temporary file unique_id = uuid.uuid4().hex temp_pdf_path = f"/tmp/{unique_id}.pdf" temp_txt_path = f"/tmp/{unique_id}.txt" # Save the uploaded file to a temporary location with open(temp_pdf_path, "wb") as temp_pdf_file: while content := await file.read(1024 * 1024): # Read in chunks to handle large files temp_pdf_file.write(content) # Use pdftotext to convert the PDF to text subprocess.run(["pdftotext", temp_pdf_path, temp_txt_path], check=True) # Read the converted text with open(temp_txt_path, "r") as temp_txt_file: text_content = temp_txt_file.read() # Clean up temporary files os.remove(temp_pdf_path) os.remove(temp_txt_path) return text_content except subprocess.CalledProcessError: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Conversion failed") except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e)) if __name__ == "__main__": import uvicorn uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
